author: Tpk42
body:
~The center has been updated! Go and check out the progress so far at imgur!~
"Eden" - A DTM map created by Tpk42.
This is a regular sized map that features a lot of vertical engagements, and a lot of building. There are three main horizontal paths that are very narrow and merge together at points, as well as 4 'tiers" of vertical paths. The center flower is very tall and should be protected at all costs!
-There is a VERY limited amount of iron blocks in the map. In exchange, there are a few chests with great items, and you come to battle a little better equipped than average, with chain armor and an iron sword. Sweet!
-Speaking of which, here is your loadout:
--A leather helmet, the rest chain mail armor
--Iron Sword
--Bow, w/ 32 arrows.
--Diamond Pickaxe (standard)
--2 Gold Apples
--Clay Blocks of your team's color
--32 Planks
-As you may notice, you don't have many blocks. Your team has to really work together in order to make it to that center flower!
-There is a secret in the map. I wonder what's inside those little flowers?
-Will you go up high and shoot away at the enemy? Or will you stick to the roots and and the leaves down below?

-Everything can be found here in my Dropbox folder (The level.dat, region files, the map.yml, and images): https://www.dropbox.com/sh/1exmk79ab9qmaaj/AAClddhrw9FLktTsB2-3TCQUa?dl=0
-Want to go straight to the images? Go here!: http://imgur.com/a/LRkq8
-Feedback is greatly appreciated! Any suggestions on improving the map in any way will be considered (espicially if i used 1.8 blocks and didn't realize it :P)
Update: The main question I have for all of you is this- Do you think the map would be improved with the flowers being bigger? This is something I've considered, and it appears to be the main issue with the map atm.
~Tpk42
Update: Version 1.2 of the map will be released soon. This update will:
Fix many of the gameplay issues (everyone falling in the void during combat)
  Flowers will either be bigger or fixed to look less blocky.
  The center will feature several smaller flowers bunched together, meaning the center will have a lot of vertical close quarters combat.
  Horizontal paths will be scaled out, giving players more breathing room.
Fix the items in chests disappearing.
Fix the issue of flatland generating further out.
Expecting the update to come out some time tomorrow. Check imgur to see the latest progress!
See you then! :D

replies.author: Tpk42
replies.body:
Thx for the initial feedback. I agree with the flowers being blocky, but after a great deal of time looking at Google Images of flowers, I found that the only way to make them look not so 'blocky' was to make them bigger, which is something that I kinda want to look into.
As far as being spread apart, for the most part I do agree. I still want part of the fun to be building from flower to flower with having to contend with the other team shooting at you. Maybe a middle ground can be found with some testing :D.
I need to ask what you mean by more fighting space PokerFace. Should the platforms be bigger, or should the paths be a little wider?

I'm initially thinking maybe the best solution would be to make the flowers bigger. I'll include this as a question in the main post. Any and all other suggestions are welcome as well. Thx again!

replies.author: steven5703
replies.body:
Love the theme, very different, creative, and original.

However, I would suggest having circles instead of diamonds for the flowers. (they're a bit blocky)
Like other's have said, you should add more land so rushing and pvp is easier.

I loaded this world up on singleplayer and I noticed that the chests were empty. I'm using 1.7, and chests formatted to 1.8 are not compatible with 1.7. But, 1.7 formatted chests are compatible with 1.8 (correct me if I'm wrong). So, I would suggest that you load this map up in 1.7 and put the items in the chest on 1.7 so if the map is accepted and put on avicus, 1.8 AND 1.7 players can see the chests. Same things go with the signs. Again, I'm not 100% sure this is how it works, so correct me if I'm wrong.

If you could fix those issues, I could see this being accepted.

EDIT: I also noticed that if you fly away from the map a bit, you can see flatlands.
http://prntscr.com/768keo

replies.author: Tpk42
replies.body:
Thx all! I'm gonna respond to you all in order:

I thought the name sounded familiar the more i though about it. Eden is a great name, and is more than likely what the map will be called.

It seems the number one problem with the map is the lack of fighting space. I did some testing w/ a friend, and I completely agree. Every kill was a viod/fall damage kill. This will be fixed.

I currently have the map.YML written up. I appreciate the offer though :D.

Robin is pointing out the issue of getting stuck. Thats something i didnt think about lol. I'll add more to balance out this issue :D.

Finally, a couple unintended and rather big issues. The chests thing is something i completely forgot about, makinig the map in 1.8. And flatland should not be generating, there must have been an issue with mcedit.

I don't expect to get much done today, since there's a lot of IRL stuff. Sunday's are always busy for me. I'll Be sure to keep you guys updated on what's happening as often as possible. Thanks again!
